desc: Read N and the sorted array A.
Initialize two pointers: `i` (top candidate, starts at 0) and `j` (bottom candidate, starts at 1).
Iterate while both pointers are within bounds: if `A[i] * 2 <= A[j]`, increment answer and both pointers; else increment `j` only.
Write the full Python code with solve() and __main__ guard, ensuring it reads from stdin and writes to stdout.
